description:
PROXIMA is a team of curious minds driven by a shared passion for astronomy, space science, and innovation. Inspired by the mysteries of the universe and the possibilities beyond our solar system, we aim to explore scientific challenges through creativity, collaboration, and technology.

We believe that every great discovery begins with a question, and every question brings us one step closer to understanding the cosmos.

Looking beyond the known. Exploring beyond the stars. We are PROXIMA.
